# ClickHouse Patterns

Curated by Skill Harbor: a patterns skill for high-performance analytics on ClickHouse, the column-oriented OLAP database. It covers MergeTree engine selection and table schema design, writing fast analytical queries (aggregations, window functions, joins), optimization techniques (partition pruning, projections, materialized views), ingesting large volumes (batch inserts, Kafka integration), migrating from PostgreSQL or MySQL to ClickHouse for analytics, and building real-time dashboards and time-series analytics. Concrete, ClickHouse-specific guidance rather than generic SQL advice. By @affaan-m, listed here with credit to its creator. From the affaan-m/ECC repository (MIT). Honest caveats: pure guidance, nothing to install; requires a ClickHouse instance for anything hands-on; OLAP only, this is not the skill for transactional (OLTP) workloads. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
